hypotheses.cause: The M label was detected as a label object but never bound to a point.

result.instruction: Geometry route: add a point object for the left diameter endpoint, labelled M, at the detected endpoint near a_px [47.0, 301.0] (shared by seg_01 and seg_diameter). result.summary: Adds only the missing left diameter endpoint M. Original image shows an unlabelled-in-render but visible 'M' below-left of the baseline's left end, at about (47, 301), which is the shared a_px of seg_01 and seg_diameter. Binds the existing label_04 to a new point_M. No existing object, coordinate or relation is changed. Stroke-width measurement was not performed (no CV calls were run), so the style issue is left open.
